recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the already-applied Jira resolution in active build inputs without changing the intentional fhir.ini release-delta aliases.
issue_request: FHIR-47622 was Applied/Persuasive for R6. It requested a dedicated Medication serial-number location because Medication.identifier was ambiguous between medication-kind identifiers and physical-instance identifiers. The accepted resolution renamed Medication.batch to Medication.instance, added Medication.instance.identifier 0..* Identifier for physical instances such as serial numbers, added a serial-number example, and ensured examples do not put serial numbers in Medication.identifier.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR 3896 and local Jira-tagged commits afb9b405cb, 35383bc5c4, 958e04e179, and 01530390fc applied most of the resolution by renaming the core Medication BackboneElement, adding Medication.instance.identifier, updating many Medication examples, and fixing a typo in the new path. The remaining current source still had stale parallel surfaces.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Medication as a current resource, making the Medication StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle build inputs. The remaining Medication.batch entries in fhir.ini are compatibility/migration aliases to Medication.instance and were intentionally left unchanged. No FHIR-47622-specific Confluence reference or conflicting Zulip decision was found.
reconciliation: Changed Medication.identifier's comment to direct physical-instance identifiers to Medication.instance.identifier, retargeted Medication-serial-number to Medication.instance.identifier, fixed Medication-lot-number's path extension to Medication.instance.lotNumber, and renamed stale contained Medication <batch> elements to <instance> in MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationStatement examples.
source_changes: source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml: updated the Medication.identifier comment to direct physical-instance identifiers to Medication.instance.identifier.
source/medication/bundle-Medication-search-params.xml: aligned lot-number and serial-number search-parameter paths/expressions with Medication.instance.lotNumber and Medication.instance.identifier.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0316.xml, medicationrequest0321.xml, medicationrequest0323.xml: renamed contained Medication batch elements to instance.
source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense0302.xml: renamed the contained Medication batch element to instance.
source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration0305.xml, medicationadministration0309.xml: renamed contained Medication batch elements to instance.
source/medicationstatement/medicationstatementexample1.xml, medicationstatementexample2.xml: renamed contained Medication batch elements to instance.
